## Reproduction / proposed validation

Give commands, inputs, coverage and expected outcomes. Counterexamples need exact rows and a witness/cut. Experiments need seeds and a completeness boundary. Formalization needs a target signature and trust assumptions. Literature audits distinguish known results from proposed novelty.
